notes.title: Westmark Manor News
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36826519/6eacd48498aa406e2f7e769203a809be8c4c8606.png[/img]

We are very excited to now be able to introduce you to our new title [b]“The Foretold: Exordium”[/b]

We had so much fun making Westmark Manor, and were so blown away by all the positive feedback and comments, that we were inspired to make the spiritual successor [b]The Foretold: Exordium[/b], which is a prequel to the upcoming Westmark Legacy title releasing in early 2024. This gothic horror adventure deck builder is inspired by the likes of H.P. Lovecraft, Stephen King and Mary Shelley to name a few.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36826519/d11e286eebae09cd5fc068dd31d748df6afa166b.png[/img]

Explore the corrupted peninsula in a stunning hand drawn art style.
You play as Herbert Westmark, paranormal investigator and curator of odd trinkets. Together with a parasite demon Ambrose you explore the map of Burrmouth to get to the bottom of why people here are missing. Where will your unhinged journey take you in this unique cosmic horror adventure?
The stylish art will set the mood to a gothic horror adventure where Herbert tries to survive by using his skills, items and deck.
Fight to investigate another day in this gothic horror adventure card game. Equip items and relics. Acquire cards and use them wisely to survive what lurks in the darkest corners of town. Take a short and mind-bending dive into the unknown with a cozy horror atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36826519/bf08658fea65016a5cd45eacaa21070b9b8c2768.png[/img]

A card game with a totally new puzzle mechanic that makes you want to think before you use your hand. A misstep can cost you dearly.

* Explore the branching roads along the world map that hold random loot, encounters and surprises.
* Dive into a deep fully voiced narrative with interesting characters.
* Branching dialogues and multiple endings.
* Persona Points allow you to level up Herbert's various skills.
* Skill Checks will allow you to test your character build.
* Build your deck against the dark corrupted things that haunt citizens of Burrmouth.

Collect items to aid you and level up your Persona in order to survive the things that hunt you.
Use your notebook together with dialogue choices to get closer to out what really is going on here.
Dig deeper with tabletop-style skill checks to see what more you can learn - but be aware that there may be risks should you fail.
Where will your unhinged journey take you in this unique cosmic horror adventure?

Although there are some connections directly to Westmark Manor, you will not need to know Westmark Manor to play [b]The Foretold: Exordium[/b]

If you enjoyed the deep dark secrets of Westmark Manor, then you are sure to love [b]The Foretold: Exordium[/b] available on Steam! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36826519/e934a14a57a4dd7b5a77ecbe50a19f2e1c914a0d.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2432680/The_Foretold_Exordium/?beta=1

* Devotees will now work smoothly.
* Rectified some spelling mistakes.

* Rectified the subtitle in the attic.
* Fixed the bench in the garden.
* Some passages in the basement tweaked.
* Flies have sound now in all places.
* Outside sound mixing fixed.
* Added GOG Galaxy manager in preparation for release.
* Crafting now auto completes.
* Water flask will not disappear after using it.
* Should not get stuck by the entrance at the Garden any more.
* Achievements fixed.
* Note list is now scroll-able.
* Box in the father's bedroom now doesn't require another key to take items from it.

* When using the crafting kit in the basement to make trinkets, it's done a couple weird things: 
[b][i]One of them is that it'll remove the wrong objects from the inventory (favours keys and tea over trinkets for some reason) and sometimes all you can see is a white rectangle in the place of the item when placing it in the crafting kit. This only happens with trinkets.[/i][/b] (Fixed)

notes.title: Patch Notes 19th June 2020
notes.content:
[h1]Today sees an update to the following items[/h1]

* Green Ring item text in the trader menu is missing . at the end (:D).
* Rectified the attic monologue triggering when re-entering the attic after completing the puzzle.
* When pouring water in the fireplace you now get a water bottle back (not an empty flask).
